scripts.ai-log:clear:
rm -f .ai/worklog.jsonl && echo '# AI Work Log

自动生成的 AI 工作日志

---
' > CHANGELOG.ai.md
scripts.ai-log:stats: cat .ai/worklog.jsonl | jq -s 'map(.data.type) | group_by(.) | map({type: .[0], count: length})'
scripts.ai-log:tools: cat .ai/worklog.jsonl | jq -r '[.data.tool] | group_by(.) | map({tool: .[0], count: length}) | sort_by(.count) | reverse'
